yonisomanasikārasamuṭṭhāna: [Yonisomanasikāra+samuṭṭhāna] (ti) CL=7 (Chandacetasita: nature of desire to do)   is cause of being/happening (Samuṭṭhāna) which is said Yonisomanasikāra. (Yonisomanasikāra means equanimity (or) philosophical attitude).
yuganandhasamathavipassanābala: [Yuganandha+samathavipassanā+bala] (na) CL=7 Same meaning as Yuganandha samatha vipassanā bala. (Bala means power (or) strength).(Samata means meditation to attain tranquillity). (Vipassanā means insight).
yujjanaṭṭha: [Yujjana+attha] (pu) CL=7 [Ttha-kiu ṭṭha-pru. Nīti, sutta.107.] Nature of combination. One way The nature which is being together. See - Yujjana-(3).
